correctness.rationale: The parity model and arithmetic claim check out. Over the algebraic closure let H be a fiber disjoint from the branch points. The even-subset map to 2-torsion respects symmetric difference by 2W_i∼H and complements by the divisor of y in an even-degree model. It is injective modulo complements: a nonempty subset of size 2 or 4 in the kernel would give a function in L(H) or L(2H) with simple zeros at the indicated ramification points, but these spaces consist of x-polynomials of degree at most 1 or 2 and such zeros have even order. Both sides have 64 elements. The 28 distinct pair classes are effective odd theta characteristics (none is H) and exhaust the odd classes; hence the quadratic parity is |S|/2 mod 2, with polar form |S∩T| mod 2. The triple condition means the indicator of edge disjointness sums to zero on every triple of heptad members. Choosing one member as reference expresses each pair indicator as the sum of two member labels in F₂. Edges therefore split into at most two intersecting families with disjoint supports across the families. An intersecting family of distinct edges lies in a star or is a triangle. Seven edges on eight vertices allow only a seven-edge star, or a four-edge star disjoint from a triangle (two nonempty stars would require nine vertices). Fixing a center and an invariant triangle gives exactly the stated fixed-count formula. A fresh exhaustive check of 1,184,040 edge sets, the 22 partitions and every power through each order confirmed the CSV including full cycle spectra and prefix cardinalities 12,19,21,22; replay branches/7cf5e8c3-6e1b-4344-a570-101694d2cbd8/independent_arons_recheck.py and independent_arons_recheck.txt. The only three-count collision is (8) versus (4,4). The irreducible-polynomial counts (q⁸−q⁴)/8 and (q⁴−q²)/4 ensure these types over each odd finite field. A separate exact F₃ trial division of the displayed octic by the 120 monic polynomials of degrees 1–4, and each quartic by the 12 of degrees 1–2, found no divisors. The geometric argument uses odd characteristic; the finite census checks only the stated permutation problem. No uploaded program was executed.
